sentences.en: She is an adult, so you should treat her accordingly.
sentences.zh: 她已经成年了，因此你应该相应地对待她。

sentences.en: Accordingly as people become rich, they are apt to be stingy.
sentences.zh: 随着人们变得富有，他们往往会变得吝啬。

sentences.en: Productivity has fallen. Accordingly, workers' bonuses will be reduced.
sentences.zh: 生产力下降了。因此，工人的奖金将会减少。

senses.zh: 照着, 相应地因此, 所以, 于是
